name: Kerala History Museum
summary: The Museum of Kerala History is one of the galleries of the Kerala Museum, run by the Madhavan Nayar Foundation at Edappally in Kochi. It tells the region's story through life-size tableaux and dioramas of historical figures and scenes, alongside a contemporary art gallery and a dolls museum on the same campus.
highlights: Life-size figure tableaux depicting episodes and personalities from Kerala's history
Part of the Kerala Museum complex run by the Madhavan Nayar Foundation
Same campus holds the Gallery of Contemporary Indian Art, The Dolls Museum and a visual art centre
Amphitheatre and events programme of talks, workshops and performances
